$meta.method: Google Maps place search, Imphal viewport (24.8074,93.9368), four category sweeps: stays, museums/galleries/craft, Manipuri cuisine, temples/parks/viewpoints.
$meta.what_this_adds: The earlier Imphal eatery data came from wanderlog, a third-party aggregator. This pass went to Maps directly and found (a) review counts an order of magnitude higher than wanderlog reported, (b) a whole heritage layer — art museums, handloom houses, indigenous Meitei temples — that no source in the first two passes touched, and (c) 20 real Imphal homestays, replacing an OTA listing dump.
$meta.warning: Ratings and review counts are a 2026-09-23 snapshot. Nothing here is phone-verified.

corrections_to_eateries_json.note: The wanderlog figures in eateries.json were stale and had no review counts. Maps direct gives the real picture — and it changes which places deserve top billing. Replace the wanderlog ratings with these.

items.name: Luxmi Kitchen
items.impact: Over 2,000 reviews. This is the single most-reviewed restaurant in Imphal and fully earns its billing as the authentic-thali anchor.

items.name: Asian Bowl
items.impact: Far more significant than treated. Korean food is clearly a major part of Imphal's eating-out culture, not a novelty.

items.name: Char-koal Restaurant Manipur
items.note: Maps categorises it as a North Eastern Indian restaurant, not just barbecue.

items.name: Mellow Imphal
items.note: Price band confirms the upper-tier classification.

items.name: Hotel Imoinu
items.impact: Open 24 hours and genuinely cheap — the obvious late-night and early-departure recommendation.

items.name: Deccan Resto Imphal
items.address_fuller: 3rd Floor, Yumnam Building, Moirang Ningthou Leirak, Mayai Lambi Rd

items.name: Chakluk Hotel
items.note: Reviews: local dishes served on banana leaves. Lower volume than its rating suggested — good, but not an anchor.

new_imphal_eateries.name: Leirung Resto
new_imphal_eateries.address: Sangaiprou Mamang Leikai, Airport Road, opposite ISKCON temple
new_imphal_eateries.note: NEW, and a major omission from every earlier source — 972 reviews at 4.7 makes it the best-rated high-volume restaurant in Imphal. On the airport road, so it works as a first or last meal.

new_imphal_eateries.name: Taste of Imphal Food Delivery Service
new_imphal_eateries.note: A local food-delivery operator — relevant if the platform ever wants in-stay meal ordering.

new_imphal_eateries.name: MIC (Multi Indigenous Cuisine)
new_imphal_eateries.note: Explicitly positions itself on indigenous cuisine — worth a call for the food-heritage thread despite the middling rating.

new_imphal_eateries.name: Chitra Burmese Restaurant
new_imphal_eateries.note: The only Burmese restaurant found in Imphal. Given the Moreh border trade, this is a genuine cross-border food story.

new_imphal_eateries.name: The Platter, Meitei Chakkhum
new_imphal_eateries.note: Reviews praise the atouba thongba. Caterer rather than sit-down — could supply experiences rather than be listed as a restaurant.

new_imphal_eateries.name: Imoinu Chakluk Manipuri Thali Restaurant
new_imphal_eateries.note: Distinct from Hotel Imoinu despite the shared name — both on the RW4M block. Verify they are separate businesses.

new_imphal_eateries.name: Chak'luk
new_imphal_eateries.address: Palace Compound, near AIR, opposite PAN Manipur
new_imphal_eateries.note: Distinct from Chakluk Hotel at Pologround.

new_imphal_eateries.name: Taste Tradition
new_imphal_eateries.address: Palace Gate, Nityaiband Chuthek – Konung Mamang Rd
new_imphal_eateries.note: Rating too low to recommend — logged so nobody re-adds it from a listicle.

not_in_manipur_exclude.note: These surfaced in a Manipuri-cuisine search but are Bengaluru businesses serving the Manipuri diaspora. Easy to mistake for Imphal listings — excluded deliberately.

items.name: Manipur indigenous food supplier
items.address: Bhati Nivash Building, 20th K-cross, Sri Rama Temple Rd, Bengaluru

items.name: Imphal Homez

heritage_and_craft.note: An entire category the first two passes missed. For a platform themed on Heritage & Culture, this is arguably the most valuable block in the whole dataset — and none of it appears in the existing hotspot seed.

museums_and_galleries.name: RKCS Art Gallery And Museum
museums_and_galleries.address: RKCS Colony, Nambul River Road, Keishamthong
museums_and_galleries.note: NEW. The gallery of RK Chandrajitsana Singh. 400 reviews and no presence in any travel source consulted.

museums_and_galleries.name: Three Mothers Art Gallery
museums_and_galleries.address: Palace Compound, Three Mothers Art Gallery Leirak, Thangapat Mapal
museums_and_galleries.note: NEW. Reviews note free entry. Highest-rated museum in Imphal.

museums_and_galleries.name: Leimayol Art Centre
museums_and_galleries.note: NEW. A performing-arts venue matters for Manipuri dance, Thang-Ta and Shumang Leela programming.

museums_and_galleries.name: Tribal Research Institute
museums_and_galleries.note: NEW. Research body, not a visitor attraction — but the right first call for tribal cultural content and permissions.

museums_and_galleries.name: Manipur State Museum
museums_and_galleries.confirms: Already in the hotspot seed — this adds a phone number.

craft_and_handloom.name: Manipur Handloom & Handicrafts Development Corporation Ltd.
craft_and_handloom.note: NEW. The state handloom body. Reviews mention bulk purchase for gifting. The right institutional partner for authenticated craft listings.

craft_and_handloom.name: Akhom Handicraft
craft_and_handloom.address: Kongba Nandeibam Leikai, Singjamei – Kongba Rd

craft_and_handloom.name: Rani Handloom House
craft_and_handloom.note: NEW. Reviews describe the owner as a national awardee — verify, it is a strong provenance claim.

craft_and_handloom.name: Crafts Handloom Village
craft_and_handloom.note: NEW. The Plus Code puts this in the Moirang/Loktak belt, not Imphal.

craft_and_handloom.name: Cafeteria Crafts Handloom Village
craft_and_handloom.note: The phone number is identical to the registered Loktak Aquamarine Homestay owner's (Ashok Sapamcha). The same operator appears to run the cafeteria at Crafts Handloom Village — one call could confirm a homestay, a campsite and a cafeteria at once.

ima_keithel.name: Ima Market
ima_keithel.note: 12,514 reviews — by a wide margin the most-reviewed place in Manipur, ahead of Kangla Fort's 6,734. Already in the seed; this quantifies just how central it is.

institutional.name: Tourism Corporation of Manipur Limited
institutional.note: The state tourism corporation's own office, with the same number the Directorate publishes. First stop for partnership and for tourist-bungalow booking.

temples_parks_viewpoints.note: Two finds here matter beyond their ratings: Hiyangthang Lairembi and Lainingthou Sanamahi Kiyong are indigenous Meitei religious sites, not Vaishnav temples. The existing seed covers Govindajee (Vaishnav) but nothing of Sanamahism, which is the older indigenous religion. That is a real gap in the heritage story.

indigenous_meitei_sites.name: Hiyangthang Lairembi Temple
indigenous_meitei_sites.note: NEW. Major temple to the goddess Hiyangthang Lairembi, on a hillock south-west of Imphal. 385 reviews and absent from every source in the first two passes.

indigenous_meitei_sites.name: Lainingthou Sanamahi Kiyong Hongba
indigenous_meitei_sites.address: R23P+F5, Sanjenbam, Nongmaiching Chingkha Lambi, Sangsabi 795010
indigenous_meitei_sites.note: NEW. The Sanamahi temple complex on the Nongmaiching slope — the centre of the indigenous Meitei faith. Highest-rated place of worship found. Approach with care: this is an active religious site, not an attraction.

indigenous_meitei_sites.name: Marjing Polo Statue
indigenous_meitei_sites.note: NEW, and listed separately from Ebudhou Marjing Eco-Tourism Park at the same hill. Marjing is the Meitei deity of polo — the statue and the park together are the strongest single 'Manipur invented polo' asset available.

vaishnav_temples.name: ISKCON Temple Imphal
vaishnav_temples.note: On the airport road — reviews point out it is easy to fit in on the way back to the airport.

vaishnav_temples.name: Shri Bijoy Govindajee Temple
vaishnav_temples.note: NEW. Reviews call it the largest Vaishnava temple in Imphal — note this is distinct from Shree Shree Govindajee at the Palace Compound.

vaishnav_temples.name: Shri Mahabali Hanuman Temple
vaishnav_temples.note: On the bank of the Imphal river. Reviews call it the oldest Hanuman temple in Manipur.

parks_and_viewpoints.name: Shilheipung Garden
parks_and_viewpoints.resolves: This is the 'Silheipung Garden, Lamlai' record in places.json, which the official source gave as a bare name with no detail. Now has a rating, 634 reviews, a phone, an address on the Imphal–Ukhrul road and opening hours. Reviews: quiet and refreshing, but needs investment.

parks_and_viewpoints.name: Pheidinga Park
parks_and_viewpoints.note: NEW. Reviews mention a children's play area, a restaurant and boating.

parks_and_viewpoints.name: In The Valley
parks_and_viewpoints.note: NEW. On the Nongmaijing slope, near the Sanamahi temple.

parks_and_viewpoints.name: Langol Laimanai Ching
parks_and_viewpoints.note: NEW, and the only thing in the whole dataset that Maps categorises as a hiking area inside Imphal. Pairs with Langol Peak Garden.

parks_and_viewpoints.name: Matai Garden
parks_and_viewpoints.confirms: Found in the previous pass — this adds a phone and an entry fee.

parks_and_viewpoints.name: Santhei Natural Park, Andro
parks_and_viewpoints.confirms: Adds a phone number to the places.json record.

parks_and_viewpoints.name: Ebudhou Marjing Eco-Tourism Park
parks_and_viewpoints.caution: One review dated 11.12.2022 says it was still under construction. Confirm completion before listing.

next_steps: Open each place's Maps detail panel to capture phone, website, full address and the weekly hours grid — the card view only shows these sometimes. Roughly one navigation per place.
Capture lat/lng from each place URL so real map pins can be dropped. Every Plus Code here also resolves to an exact point.

Call Tourism Corporation of Manipur (0385 242 1794) and the Handloom & Handicrafts Corporation (0385 244 2381) — institutional partners who can authenticate craft and stay listings at scale rather than one business at a time.
Call 080149 21286 once: it appears to cover Loktak Aquamarine Homestay, the Takmu campsite and the Crafts Handloom Village cafeteria.

Decide the cultural protocol for Lainingthou Sanamahi Kiyong and Hiyangthang Lairembi before publishing them. These are active indigenous religious sites and should be presented on the community's terms.
